x: For the Youths, keep in touch with Les Stokell and Tom Carter, they will know all about the fixtures and will advise you of events in which to take part.

Under the guidance of Tom Carter and Les Stokell the lads have made tremendous strides during the winter months. Regular Tuesday evening and Saturday afternoon pack training from the Hall with Tom has brought a tremendous team spirit, and with it an improvement in performance.

Our other men to finish, with nine to compete and six to score, were Les Stokell 64th, Albert Frost 95th, and finally Dick Tobin 132nd. It is interesting to note that Denis Brickwood finished in 80th place, and was then running for Mitcham A.C., and it is perhaps sad to reflect that of our team memb…

The Southern Champs the following month at Eastbourne at which the Club usually made a strong showing resulted in another 4th place behind T.V.H., Aylesford and Blackheath, our first man home being Les Stokell with a good performance by evergreen Ted Stimpson in 21st place.
Albert Frost unfortunately had a bad time but Tom Carter was running well and eventually became our sixth scoring man with Les Stokell unluckily missing a winner's medal by two places.
